source_ref: Centro de Investigaciones Sociológicas (CIS), Estudio 3130 'Actitudes hacia la cooperación internacional (II)', February 2016, N=2453. Study page https://www.cis.es/es/estudios/actitudes-hacia-la-cooperacion-internacional-ii- ; microdata https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/1556286/MD3130.zip (md5 c13ec6ab4d285f5f395f78d5b8f9bef6, re-fetched 2026-09-23) containing ES3130 (SPSS syntax: DATA LIST, VARIABLE LABELS, VALUE LABELS), DA3130 (fixed-width data) and cues3130.pdf (questionnaire, md5 3abc680453c2e2aa6d7c37f4c3153f54), P.1 col (28) and P.2 cols (29)-(36). Processing script data/spain_2016_cooperation.do, Bookmark 1: interest. Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: ES3130's VARIABLE LABELS tie each column to its question -- P1 'Grado de atención a las cuestiones internacionales', P201 'La Unión Europea (UE)', P202 'Rusia y las Repúblicas de la antigua Unión Soviética', P203 'América Latina', P204 'Estados Unidos', P205 'El Norte de África (Marruecos, Argelia, etc.)', P206 'China', P207 'África subsahariana', P208 'Oriente Medio' -- and its VALUE LABELS give P1 1 'Mucha' 2 'Bastante' 3 'Poca' 4 'Ninguna' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.' and P201-P208 (identical for all eight) 1 'Mucho' 2 'Bastante' 3 'Poco' 4 'Ninguno' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.'. The questionnaire independently prints the same card columns: P.1 (28), P.2 region rows (29)..(36) in the same order as P201..P208. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: the .do infixes DA3130 at the ES3130 DATA LIST positions (p1 28, p201-p208 29-36, identical to ES3130) and sets item = the lowercased source variable name, so the codes ARE the CIS names -- Step 5b exempt, no verification row or verify_*.R. CHECKED ANYWAY, no new export: reading DA3130 (2453 records) at cols 28-36 and dropping 8/9 as the .do does reproduces the live item x resp table cell for cell, all 36 cells (e.g. p1 341/1091/790/221, p201 353/1126/748/206, p202 144/638/1101/552, p208 212/881/902/439; live table from the local irw cache table_context.R had already written). irw_table_sets(per_item=TRUE), server-side: n_rows 21905; per-item n p1 2443, p201 2433, p202 2435, p203 2434, p204 2434, p205 2429, p206 2432, p207 2431, p208 2434; resp {1,2,3,4}, all four levels used by every item. Dropped 8/9 are small (10-25 per item, <=1%). Semantic check: mean resp (1=Mucho) is lowest for the EU (2.30, most interest) and highest for Russia/China/sub-Saharan Africa (~2.8), as expected for a Spanish sample. text_source=study_materials: item_text, section_prompt and option_text transcribed from cues3130.pdf via pdftotext -layout (the plain rendering interleaves the two columns). Deviations, all mechanical: leading '- ' bullets and dot leaders stripped; line-break hyphenation rejoined ('Ma-rruecos' -> 'Marruecos'; the P.2 column headers print 'Mu- cho', 'Bas- tante', 'Nin- guno', shipped as 'Mucho', 'Bastante', 'Ninguno', which equal the value labels); 'Africa' kept unaccented in p205/p207 as the questionnaire prints it in P.2 (the ES3130 labels and elsewhere in the questionnaire write 'África'). P.1's opening 'Para empezar,' kept as administered. STRUCTURE: two sections. p1 is P.1, a standalone question on ATTENTION to news about other countries (section _1, blank prompt, full question as item_text; anchors feminine Mucha/Poca/Ninguna agreeing with 'atención'). p201-p208 are the eight rows of P.2, a grid on INTEREST in news about international issues concerning each region; the P.2 stem is their section_prompt (section _2) and the region label is item_text. instructions blank: no text spans the whole table (the interview greeting is generic). Anchors differ between P.1 and P.2, so option rows are item-specific. Step 3b: dictionary Description 'Attention to international affairs and interest in eight world regions' matches P1 + P201-P208 exactly; no instrument mismatch. Note the table pools two distinct questions (attention vs interest) on parallel 4-point scales -- a property of the processing script, not an extraction choice. translation_source=machine_translation: the _translated columns were written by IRW; CIS publishes this questionnaire only in Spanish. RIGHTS: no block. Originator is CIS. instrument_rights_register.csv carries a Ben-ratified CIS 'allow' row (2026-09-22), scoped in words to spain_2025_* but naming the CIS originator; applied here as batch_322 did, and the verdict independently re-derived from CIS's reuse-conditions page (fetched 2026-09-23, sha256 23d30c6e6d79f008e564d1eb4d42a773c2c66a2a550aa5833c1b60950e5948f1; the register notes the page has no stable hash, so the clause text was re-read): 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilización de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales' and 'Esta autorización conlleva, asimismo, la cesión gratuita y no exclusiva de los derechos de propiedad intelectual'. Conditions are attribution/no distortion only -- no reserved right under irw#1945. No register row written; widening the CIS row's scope to spain_2016_* is for the orchestrator/Ben. Siblings spain_2016_cooperation_awareness/duty/funding (batch_322) not touched.
public_note: The English in the _translated columns was machine-translated by IRW from the Spanish CIS administered (CIS publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only); note that p1 asks how much attention the respondent pays to news about other countries, while p201-p208 ask about interest in international news concerning each region, so the table pools two related but distinct questions on parallel 4-point scales (1 = Mucha/Mucho ... 4 = Ninguna/Ninguno).

source_ref: Centro de Investigaciones Sociologicas (CIS), Estudio 3473 'Felicidad y valores sociales', CATI fieldwork 26-28 June 2024, N=2843 (FT3473.pdf). Microdata package https://www.cis.es/documents/d/guest/md3473 (md5 a71f64f05046ee56dc6fa1bf7a75bc0f) containing ES3473 SPSS syntax (VARIABLE LABELS / VALUE LABELS, latin-1), 3473.sav, 3473_csv.zip (3473_num.csv, the processing script's input), DA3473 and cues3473.pdf; questionnaire also at https://www.cis.es/documents/d/guest/cues3473 (byte-identical to the zip copy, sha256 a45323453cf15aaee151df8ee57831ecda6c3e90e5e30025012dac45c58b1713), page 3, P.10 [P10] and P.11 [P11]. Processing script data/spain_2024_values.do (Bookmark 4: difficulty). Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: ES3473 (CIS SPSS syntax) VARIABLE LABELS P10 'Grado de dificultad para enfrentarse a los problemas importantes de la vida cotidiana' and P11 'Grado de dificultad del hogar para llegar a fin de mes'; VALUE LABELS for both 1 'Muy fácil' 2 'Fácil' 3 '(NO LEER) Ni fácil ni difícil' 4 'Difícil' 5 'Muy difícil' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.' -- identical in 3473.sav's variable and value labels. Derivation: data/spain_2024_values.do imports 3473_num.csv with case(lower) and sets item = the source variable name, so the codes ARE the CIS names (P10 -> p10, P11 -> p11); no positional step. Re-running the .do logic on 3473_num.csv (id = row number, drop 3/8/9) reproduces the live table exactly: p10 145/1524/856/137 and p11 353/1323/754/286 at resp 1/2/4/5, ids and resp values identical row for row to the live table (checked against the locally cached irw_fetch copy made by table_context.R; no new export). text_source=study_materials: item_text and option_text transcribed verbatim from cues3473.pdf, read from pdftotext -layout (P.10/P.11 sit in the right column of p.3) and cross-checked against the raw pdftotext rendering, which gives the same stem wording. Anchors are the questionnaire's printed options, which match the value labels. P.10 and P.11 are standalone questions with no shared carrier text, so instructions and section_prompt are blank. translation_source=machine_translation: the English in the _translated columns was written by IRW; CIS publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only. RESP: live set 1,2,4,5. Code 3 '(NO LEER) Ni fácil ni difícil' (volunteered, not read aloud; p10 141 and p11 107 of 2843 respondents, 5.0% and 3.8%) is set to missing by the .do file along with 8/9 (p10 17/23, p11 5/15), so no option row is shipped for 3; the scale in the table is therefore 1,2,4,5 with a gap at 3. Step 3b: dictionary Description 'Reported ease or difficulty coping with everyday problems and making ends meet' matches P10+P11; no mismatch. RIGHTS: no block. The wording's originator is CIS, a Spanish public body. The register's CIS allow row (2026-09-22) is scoped in words to spain_2025_* / Estudio 3493 and siblings, so it was not applied mechanically; the verdict was derived afresh from CIS's reuse-conditions page, fetched 2026-09-23 (200; sha256 72e23fa85b1787f695dd4a0ee5de409788a07ecaf402833f30e717c71b08d266, not a stable hash per the register row, operative text re-read instead), which grants rather than reserves: 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilización de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales' and 'la cesión gratuita y no exclusiva de los derechos de propiedad intelectual ... autorizándose la realización de actividades de reproducción, distribución, comunicación pública o transformación'; conditions are attribution ('Origen de los datos: Centro de Investigaciones Sociológicas'), no distortion, no implied official character. No fee, permission, NC or ND clause. The terms are CIS-wide, not study-specific, so the same reading reaches Estudio 3473; no register row written (a round may not write a ship/allow row) -- widening the CIS row's scope to spain_2024_* is for the orchestrator/Ben. Siblings: the same md3473 package and cues3473.pdf also cover spain_2024_values_institutions (P6_1-4), _meaning (P5, P7_1-4), _values (P8_1-3) and _political (ESCIDEOL, PROBVOTO); only P10/P11 were extracted here.
public_note: The English item and response-option wording for this table was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes this questionnaire only in Spanish; the administered Spanish is in the base fields. Respondents could also volunteer 'Ni fácil ni difícil' (neither easy nor difficult; CIS code 3, not read aloud, 5.0% on p10 and 3.8% on p11), which the IRW processing script treats as missing, so the data hold only codes 1, 2, 4 and 5

source_ref: Centro de Investigaciones Sociológicas (CIS), Estudio 3473 'Felicidad y valores sociales' (2,843 interviews). Study page https://www.cis.es/es/estudios/felicidad-y-valores-sociales ; microdata package https://www.cis.es/documents/d/guest/md3473 (md5 a71f64f05046ee56dc6fa1bf7a75bc0f) containing SPSS syntax ES3473 (VARIABLE LABELS, VALUE LABELS), 3473.sav, 3473_csv.zip (3473_num.csv, the file the .do reads) and questionnaire cues3473.pdf, P.6. Processing script data/spain_2024_values.do, Bookmark 1: institutions. Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: CIS's syntax file ES3473 (and identically the variable labels of 3473.sav) ties each column to its statement -- /P6_1 'Además del matrimonio, existen muchas otras formas aceptables de relacionarse en pareja', /P6_2 'Los colegios y los institutos cada vez tienen menor peso en la formación de los/as niños/as y de los/as jóvenes', /P6_3 'Hoy en día, pocas personas se sienten identificadas con una clase social concreta', /P6_4 'Las ideologías políticas cada vez influyen menos en nuestra forma de pensar' -- and its VALUE LABELS give, for all four, 1 'Muy de acuerdo' 2 'De acuerdo' 3 '(NO LEER) Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo' 4 'En desacuerdo' 5 'Muy en desacuerdo' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.'. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2024_values.do imports 3473_num.csv with case(lower) and sets gen item = the variable name, so p6_1..p6_4 ARE the CIS column names lowercased -- Step 5b exempt, no verification row or verify script written. CHECKED ANYWAY, decisively: tabulating P6_1..P6_4 in 3473_num.csv (and 3473.sav, identical) and dropping 8/9 and 3 as the .do does reproduces the live item x resp table cell for cell -- p6_1 1:1354 2:1194 4:202 5:56; p6_2 471/1051/954/246; p6_3 276/1393/944/118; p6_4 273/730/1185/586. Live per-item n from irw::irw_table_sets(per_item=TRUE): 2806/2722/2731/2774, n_rows 11033; the per-level table came from the local irw cache that table_context.R had already filled, no new export. The four level profiles are all distinct (p6_1 is 91% agree, p6_4 is 64% disagree), so every item is distinguished from every other and the resp direction (1 = Muy de acuerdo) is confirmed against the file's own value labels. text_source=study_materials: item_text transcribed verbatim from the questionnaire cues3473.pdf P.6 grid (md5 1a21c97d874cd3d37bb37908f87f1ba2, inside the package above; read from the pdftotext -layout rendering). One wording difference between the two CIS sources: P6_2's questionnaire reads 'de los niños/as y de los jóvenes' while the syntax/.sav label reads 'de los/as niños/as y de los/as jóvenes'; the questionnaire (what the interviewer read) is shipped. The other three agree character for character. instructions is P.6's read-aloud question verbatim; the questionnaire's following interviewer direction '(ENTREVISTADOR/A: LEER UNA A UNA Y ANOTAR. LAS AFIRMACIONES ROTAN)' is not addressed to the respondent and is not shipped -- note the four statements were administered in rotated order. option_text is the questionnaire/value-label anchors verbatim. section_prompt blank, one trivial section_id. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3473 in Spanish only; all four _translated columns were written by IRW. RESP: live set 1,2,4,5. The .do drops 8 N.S. and 9 N.C. and ALSO recodes 3 '(NO LEER) Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo' (volunteered, not read aloud; 12/29/34/19 respondents) to missing, so no option row exists for 3 and the stored scale has a gap at 3. resp is NOT renumbered: 1 = most agreement, 5 = most disagreement. Step 3b: dictionary Description 'Agreement with statements about marriage, schools, social class, and political ideology' matches P6_1..P6_4 exactly; no instrument mismatch. SIBLINGS: md3473/cues3473.pdf also cover spain_2024_values_difficulty (P10/P11, another agent this round), _meaning, _values and _political; none of their files were written. RIGHTS: no block. Originator of the wording is CIS itself. instrument_rights_register.csv carries a Ben-ratified CIS row (verdict 'allow', 2026-09-22) whose scope is worded as spain_2025_* but which names the CIS originator; for this 2024 CIS study the verdict was derived afresh from CIS's reuse-conditions page, fetched 2026-09-23 (sha256 ef68e06ec0422c61dc4716f230f8cbaf8b943abec010cb50e0ffd81f84fbe1fa; the register records that this page has no stable hash, so the clause text was re-read): 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilización de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales', 'La reutilización autorizada incluye, a modo ilustrativo, actividades como la copia, difusión, modificación, adaptación, extracción, reordenación y combinación de la información', and 'Esta autorización conlleva, asimismo, la cesión gratuita y no exclusiva de los derechos de propiedad intelectual'. An affirmative grant; conditions are attribution, no distortion and no claim of official status, none a reserved right under irw#1945. Same conclusion as the register row. No register row written (a round may not write allow/ship rows); widening the CIS row's scope to spain_2024_* is for the orchestrator/Ben.
